title: Lottery vendor job, pension and current playing
summary: Worked about 36 years as a lottery vendor, is now 68 on a pension, shows his Epiphone banjo and still plays picnic jobs.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music
